releases.description:
# TCG Binder 1.3.0

Collection management grows up: acquisition dates, smarter ownership matching, and quality-of-life actions.

## Added

- **Acquisition dates**: every card records the date it actually entered a collection (`added` in the entry) — stamped on adds, imports, and when a set-checklist line gets its first copy. The collection view gains a **period filter** (last 7/30/90 days) and **date sorting** (newest/oldest first).
- **Search by printed number**: type the fraction printed on the card — `194/198` — and the set is identified by its printed size.
- **Move between collections**: a new row action moves a card line to another collection, preserving quantity, variant, condition and the original acquisition date (merging if the destination already has it).
- **Remove from the grid**: card tiles now have an inline remove button over the art.

## Changed

- **Ownership matches the game's rules**: "Missing from collection" and the playset indicator now aggregate by card *name* across every printing and collection — owning Switch from one set satisfies a deck line for Switch from another.
- **Cross-language identity**: card notes store the canonical English name (`name-en`) when created in another language, so a collection in Portuguese and a deck in English still recognize each other. Existing notes are backfilled by "Fetch missing images".

releases.description:
# TCG Binder 1.2.3

Smarter name search.

## Fixed

- **Recent printings no longer get buried**: name results are sorted newest set first (the API returns oldest first), and the result window is much larger — searching "Switch"/"Substituição" now surfaces the current printing instead of cutting it off behind decade-old reprints.
- **Printed symbol abbreviations match**: queries are matched token by token, so "Rocky F Energy" finds "Rocky Fighting Energy" (works for all energy types), and accents are optional — "substituicao" finds "Substituição".

releases.description:
# TCG Binder 1.2.2

Better images for cards the card database doesn't cover.

## Added

- **Second image source in the backfill**: when TCGdex has no scan, "Fetch missing images" now probes the pokemontcg.io image CDN (no API key involved) and uses it when the scan exists — every URL is verified before being written to a note. Fills most basic energies and older promos.
- **Card-back fallback**: cards with no scan anywhere (e.g. brand-new promo sets) now show the classic card back instead of an empty placeholder — in collection tables, grid tiles and search results. Embedded in the stylesheet, so it works offline. Once a scan is published, "Fetch missing images" replaces it with the real art.

# TCG Binder 1.2.1

Small resilience patch for card images in search results.

## Fixed

- **Search images survive CDN hiccups**: when the low-resolution scan fails to load, the high-resolution one is tried before giving up; images that still fail render as a clean placeholder frame instead of a broken-image icon, and the exact failing URL is logged to the console for troubleshooting.

releases.description:
# TCG Binder 1.2.0

Fixes for two 1.1.0 issues and a new image-backfill tool.

## Added

- **Fetch missing images** (dashboard button + command): scans card notes without an image and backfills them from the card database — useful when a scan is published after you added the card. The note body only gains an embed if it has no image yet; your notes stay yours.

## Fixed

- **Images broke with a non-English card language**: TCGdex advertises localized image paths (e.g. `/pt/`) that don't exist on its CDN. All image URLs are now normalized to the always-available English scans — card names, search and set names remain localized.
- **List/grid toggle overlapped the search input's clear button** — moved to the left of the input.

# TCG Binder 1.1.0

Quality-of-life release: card language support, a card grid view and searchable settings.

## Added

- **Card language** setting (English, Português, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, 日本語 — via TCGdex). Card names, search and new card notes use the selected language.
  - **Name search is language-independent**: it queries your language *and* English, merged — "Caixa Secreta" and "Secret Box" both find the card.
  - Lookups fall back to English wherever a translation or scan is missing; card ids are identical across languages, so existing collections and decks are unaffected.
- **Card grid view**: toggle between list and card tiles in collections, decks and the search modal (button in each surface). Deck tiles show a quantity badge over the art; collection tiles show condition and the playset pill. A new **Default view** setting controls how surfaces start out.
- **Loading indicator** in the card search prompt while a request is in flight (static fallback under reduced motion).

## Changed

- Settings adopt Obsidian 1.13's **declarative settings API**: they now appear in the settings search, and the binder folder field uses the native folder suggester with inline validation. Older Obsidian versions (1.8.7+) keep the previous settings panel.

## Fixed

- Search results without a scan keep grid tiles aligned with a placeholder frame.

# TCG Binder 1.0.1

Security-focused patch release, addressing the Obsidian plugin review scan.

## Changed

- **All vault access is now scoped to the binder folder** (default `TCG Binder/`). The plugin no longer enumerates the vault (`getMarkdownFiles`) — it walks only its own folder tree, so file paths outside it are never seen. Privacy by construction, and faster on large vaults.

## Breaking

- Manual card notes (and any plugin-managed note) must now live **inside the binder folder** to be recognized. If you kept card notes elsewhere, move them into the folder configured in Settings → TCG Binder.

## Notes for reviewers

- **Clipboard access** is write-only and user-initiated: the "Export deck" command copies a decklist in the Pokémon TCG Live format for pasting into the official client. The plugin never reads the clipboard.

releases.description:
# TCG Binder 1.0.0

First public release. TCG Binder manages your Pokémon TCG collections, decks and cards as plain Markdown notes inside your vault — your data stays readable, syncable and linkable, with or without the plugin.

## Highlights

- 📇 **Collections in Markdown** — every collection, deck and card is a note with frontmatter; the storage format *is* the export
- ⚡ **Bulk entry** — paste a TCG Live list (`4 Pikachu ex SVI 45`) or a CSV from ManaBox/Collectr/TCG Collector and import hundreds of cards at once
- 🃏 **Deck building with live validation** — 60-card rule, copy limits (basic energy exempt) and per-card format legality, plus TCG Live import/export
- 🎯 **Set tracking** — generate a full checklist for any set (secrets included) and watch the completion bar fill
- 💰 **Free price tooling** — market prices, cost-to-completion per set and a local portfolio value history chart

## Added

### Collections
- Card search by name or set + number (`SVI 45`), with card images in the results
- Rapid entry loop: search → variant/condition/quantity → keep searching
- Variant lines per card (normal, holo, reverse holo, promo) with inline editing; duplicate lines merge automatically
- Condition tracking (NM–DMG) with color-coded badges
- Playset indicator when you own 4+ copies of a card
- Set collections: full checklist of any set at quantity 0, with per-set completion % and cost to completion
- Wishlists (excluded from deck availability and portfolio value)

### Decks
- Import decklists in the Pokémon TCG Live text format; export back to the clipboard
- Live validation: deck size, copy limits with basic-energy exemption, format legality (Standard/Expanded/Unlimited)
- Pokémon/Trainer/Energy grouping with card thumbnails
- "Missing from collection" report with the cost to complete the deck

### Import & data
- CSV import with header detection for ManaBox, Collectr and TCG Collector exports
- Card database: TCGdex by default (free, no key); pokemontcg.io supported with an API key
- Offline-friendly: set catalog and set contents cached on disk with stale fallback
- Manual cards: any note with the right frontmatter is a valid card, even if missing from the database

### Pricing
- Market prices (TCGplayer, USD) stamped on card notes with the snapshot date
- "Update prices" command with portfolio value snapshots and a history chart

### Interface
- Binder dashboard with stats, collections, decks and portfolio chart
- Follows your Obsidian theme (light/dark) and respects reduced motion
- English and Brazilian Portuguese localization

## Install

Not yet in the community store. Either:

- **BRAT**: add `bgarciamoura/obsidian-tcg-binder` as a beta plugin, or
- **Manual**: download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/tcg-binder/` and enable TCG Binder in Settings → Community plugins.

Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. Works on desktop and mobile.
